Hi Lisa — thanks for the clear ask and timeline.

I've attached two starter artifacts: a one-page Win Plan (Google Doc) that teams can use as the single source of truth during evaluation, and a 3-slide Evaluation Cadence (Google Slides) designed for procurement/exec signoff. Both are intentionally minimal so you can drop in your internal owners and target dates.

Quick notes on how we typically run the 30/60/90:
- Week 0: kickoff + infra checklist (KMS, VPC routing, data usage boundaries)
- Days 3–14: smoke tests, baseline latency/cost metrics, and an acceptance prompt set run
- Days 15–45: feature-focused trials (integration with EHR stub, API scale tests)
- Day 46–90: consolidation, exec review, procurement sign-off, and pilot extension decision

Next steps I propose:
1) You and your PM drop owners into the Win Plan doc (link below).
2) We set a 30-min review with infra and procurement — suggest Wed, Jul 21 10:00 AM PT.
3) I'll preload a list of the standard artifacts procurement usually asks for in the doc (SOC 2 link, audit log excerpt sample, retention policy).

Vivek — looping in a few practical edits I usually make to the starter so pilots run smoothly: 

- Add an "Infra gating checklist" section with explicit owners and ticket links (IAM, VPC peering, cert thumbprints).
- Under success criteria include a "safety & data handling" row: permissible prompt categories, PII handling, and retention expectations.
- A small row for "fallback plan" if throughput drops (recommended model variants + fallback region).

Also adding a quick procurement cheat sheet to the Slides: what to include for SOC2 evidence, sample SLA request language, and typical PO timelines. I'll populate those this afternoon.
